propositions: A no-mapping store must be migrated by seeding `.bridge_state/projects.json` with a `legacy_default` equal to the configured backend project, enabling ticket resolution without operator action.

The migration must write zero ticket events to avoid lock contention on MCP boot; instead one mapping write per store records the default and allows `resolve_project` to treat every absent-field ticket as belonging to it.
Two idempotent ensure units (seed-mapping and converge-capability-stamp) must be registered in the ensures.py registry and execute at init, re-init, fsck --repair, and MCP boot.
A one-project mapping must leave `required_capabilities` empty; a multi-project mapping must add exactly `multi-project-bridge` as a convergence backstop when the capability stamp is missing.
The seed unit must write zero commits on second run (tree-check against committed blob) and only fire when the store has existing tickets.
A two-project stamped store must still pass `check_store_compat` on this binary, and failing units must be recorded as `failed` without aborting the sweep.
